title: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager - Projects
description:
**What We Offer**
 At Evonik, you’re part of a global chemical company working in many sectors that go beyond chemistry. From lipids for tomorrow’s medicines, biosurfactants for green detergents, additives for plastics recycling or membranes to help drive forward the energy transition, you’ll play an essential part in helping the world’s most essential industries succeed.
   

  

 Our success hinges on a diversity of ideas powered by people, not egos. Whether you’re a scientist or engineer, new to the team or established, in business, production, or anything in between – we cheer each other on. Because we believe we can do anything. Explore everything. And Be Part of Something Special!
   

  

**Find out more about the many benefits we offer:**
 https://www.evonik.com/en/careers/why.html
   

  

**Meet the team and get to know the people behind Evonik:**
 https://www.evonik.com/en/news/meet\-the\-team.html
   

  

**Job Title : Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager \- Projects**
**Reporting to : Manager \- Projects**
**Work Location : Dombivli**
**Entity : Evonik Catalysts India Pvt. Ltd.**
**Purpose of the Position :**
 To prepare PRN for Service Reports, Job measurements, PTW issuing \& closing, project execution. Keep project documentation update.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* The position is responsible for all project activities of mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, civil, construction and execution.
* To prepare the project w.r.t user requirement \& accordingly prepare the P\& ID, material’s Bill of Quantity, Activities Gantt Chart \& Estimation cost of project.
* To prepare or check the specifications \& keep technical records separately for each project.
* To co\-ordinate with internal customers as well as contracting team by coordination with engineering/production department \& to ensure all planned activities should be complete within allocated timeline.
* To guides and supervises the engineering contractor during engineering phases and supports for understanding of ESHQ guidelines during PTW \[Permit To Work] process.
* To prepare EPIC \[Enhanced Project and Investment controlling] /PR \[Purchase Requisition] /GRN \[Goods Received Note] for all project procurement through ERP system.
* To ensure statutory compliance before start of Project Execution \& also keep, maintain all project documentation up to date in the system.
* To prepare Monthly cost Reports in coordination with Finance team which shall also include the Project status, action plan on delayed items \& Budget vs Actual comparison sheet \& provides quality\-related documents and supports the qualification phases (DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ) of an investment project.
* To prepare \& monitor the budget vs actual sheet of all projects on monthly basis to track.
* To upgrade the safety standards of ECI, follow \& execute project activities as per ECI Safety guideline


**Education, Certification, And Relevant Experience**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (Civil, Chemical, or Mechanical).
* Minimum 7 to 8 years of experience in the chemical industry.
* Must have prior experience working on projects for chemical companies.


**Additional Skills And Abilities**
* Ability to work effectively under pressure.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Relevant technical knowledge and competency in applying problem\-solving tools.
* Proactive, open, honest, and respectful in interactions, with a willingness to support others.
* Commitment to adhering to and monitoring compliance with all required safety standards in the plant as per process requirements.


**Technical Knowledge**
* Proficient in Project Management, SAP, and design tools such as AutoCAD or Pro Catia.
* Familiarity with 5S methodology and the ability to apply Cause \& Effect tools for problem\-solving.
* Basic knowledge of environmental protection units and understanding of legal requirements applicable to the site.


**Your Application**
 To ensure that your application is proceeded as quickly as possible and to protect the environment, please apply online via our careers portal. Further information about Evonik as Employer can be found at www.evonik.com/en/careers.html.
   

  

 Please address your application to the Talent Acquisition Manager, stating your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
   

  

**Your Talent Acquisition Manager:**
 Sagar Khedekar
   

  

 Company is
   

  

 Evonik Catalysts Ind

title: Finance Business Controller- West & North
description:
**About Us:**
 Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.
   

  

 At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organization reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.
   

  

 With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.
   

  

 Join us as we harness cutting\-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.
   

  

**Role and Responsibilities:**
**Guardian of the PnL and financial health**
* Monitors and drives actions to ensure accurate gross profit is reflected in the PnL, at total entity/country level down to job/shipment level.
* Coordinates improvements on upstream issues impacting job costing and financial transparency, working closely with FINOPS colleagues and ensure correct usage of approved material codes
* Actively oversees and drives improvements on financial risk and exposure originated from operational processes impacting receivables and payables
* Makes final validation of monthly accruals and overall result.


**Bridge between Operations and Finance**
* Ensures file management controls are followed and that a proper mindset on Revenue Assurance and Standards is in place.
* Oversees key operational processes by ensuring quality, accuracy, completeness and timeliness of revenue and cost are updated in system by execution teams.
* Review the use of ‘to\-be\-deactivated’ and incorrect material codes \& liaise with MMD team for support to switch to correct codes
* Perform Risk and Compliance assessment as required in the RICC Manual, within BCO scope. This also includes actively supporting effective resolution of audit findings.


**Proactively prevent issues**
* Discovers gaps in existing process to prevent negative impacts on PnL accuracy and financial health, avoiding potential audit findings.
* Identifies risks on new service offerings and processes and review with other functions to mitigate/reduce/avoid.
* Works together with CX in the implementation of new customers to avoid pitfalls in the future process to ensure customer satisfaction while safeguarding potential financial exposure.


**Add value to the bottom line**
* Act as business partner to CX/FINOPS and Area Management to identify and drive resolution of revenue/costs leakages
* Focus on loss making and under performing businesses, providing insights on reasons behind it and solutions on how to turnaround


 Other ad\-hoc duties as assigned
   

  

**Qualifications:**
 Degree in Accounting or Finance
   

  

 Chartered Accountant /MBA
   

  

**Minimum 10 Years Working Experience.**
 Knowledge in local tax rules and compliance
   

  

 Proven experience in financial analysis, financial modelling,
   

  

 Working knowledge on Warehouse business is advantage
   

  

**Skills \& Others:**
* Experience and business acumen in country logistics is highly preferred
* Proficiency in MS Office applications, especially spreadsheet and presentation tools (eg. Microsoft EXCEL, Access, Powerpoint, etc)
* Excellent command of written and spoken English
* Able to work under pressure, undertake challenges and take the initiative
* Analytical, strong planning, presentation, and organizational skills
* Self\-motivated, result driven and can be counted on to exceed goals successfully
* Ability to work with large volume of data
* Good command of Microsoft Office applications
* Collaboration skills and Stakeholder management skills
* Strong analytical and presentation skills


 Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
   

  

 We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Assistant Manager Finance
description:
**What You'll Do** 




 o Implement financial strategies, policies, and procedures to support the organization's financial objectives and ensure compliance with regulations.
 



 o Assist in the day\-to\-day financial operations of the organization, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
 



 o Monitor and analyze financial performance, identify areas of improvement, and provide recommendations to optimize the organization's financial resources.
 



 o Prepare and present financial statements, reports, and analysis to the management team and key stakeholders.
 



 o Manage cash flow, working capital, and liquidity to ensure the organization 's financial stability and growth.
 



 o Implement effective internal controls to safeguard assets, manage risks, and ensure accuracy and integrity of financial transactions and records.
 



 o Coordinate external audits, tax filings, and compliance with regulatory requirements.
 



 o Stay updated with industry trends, best practices, and changes in financial regulations to ensure the organization's financial practices are in line with the latest standards.
 



  
 



**Skills/Qualifications** 




 o Minimum 3\+ years’ experience in financial management
 



 o Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field. A master's degree or professional certification such as CA (Chartered Accountant) are desirable.
 



 o Proven experience in financial management, accounting, or related roles.
 



 o Strong knowledge of financial principles, practices, and regulations, including GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles).
 



 o Proficiency in financial analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and financial modelling.
 



 o Excellent understanding of financial statements, financial ratios, and key performance indicators (KPIs)
 



 o Experience in managing cash flow, working capital, and financial risk.
 



 o Proficiency in using financial software and tools for data analysis and reporting.
 



 o Advanced proficiency in MS Excel.
 



 o Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify financial trends, risks, and opportunities.
 



 o Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present financial information to non\-financial stakeholders.
 



 o Capacity to collaborate and coordinate with cross\-functional teams.
 



 o Attention to detail, accuracy, and integrity in financial reporting and record\-keeping.
 



 o Ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment, adapting to changing priorities and deadlines
 



 o Experience in legal / financial services / insurance industry is preferred.

title: Ecommerce Business Manager
description:
Role Overview
 
  





 We are looking for a
 **E\-Commerce Business manager** 
 to own the end\-to\-end e\-commerce business across the company’s
 **own digital platform and third\-party marketplaces** 
 .
 



 The role will combine
 **e\-commerce operations, P\&L ownership, business growth, marketplace management, inventory and supply chain coordination, customer experience, and cross\-functional leadership** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate should understand the complete e\-commerce ecosystem — from product listing and inventory availability to order processing, fulfilment, customer experience, marketplace performance, profitability, and business growth.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience managing ecommerce platforms (e.g., marketplaces or branded online stores), including catalog management and order processing.
* Skills in sales analysis, data\-driven decision\-making, and reporting on ecommerce performance metrics.
* Ability to coordinate with marketing teams on digital campaigns, promotions, and customer acquisition strategies.
* Strong organizational and operational skills for inventory tracking, vendor coordination, and logistics oversight.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team collaboration abilities.
* Proven experience in ecommerce, retail, or business management; prior leadership or P\&L responsibility is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field; advanced certifications in ecommerce or digital business are a plus.
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and continuous improvement.
